english: Hey, can we stop by that shop?
Charles, is there still something\nyou want to see?
There are so many cute things.\nCharles must be having fun too.
W-wow, that shop's lined with\nlots of pictures of mostly-naked people…!
That's a little too early for you~.\nOkay, everyone, about-face~.
Aren't you about the same yourself?
Hm? Well, yeah. Kyararin☆
I don't get that spell of yours either.
Fwaah…
Haruka, you look sleepy.\nWhat were you up to all night?
U-um, I was reading manga\na little too late… *yawn*.
(It's really because I've been\nsearching for the Poketen at night…)
Aoi, you look pale. Are you okay?
I-I'm fine. Like Haruka,\nI'm just a little sleep-deprived…
// Aoi collapses
Aoi!? Aoi! What's wrong!!
Calm down, Haruka.\n…Yeah, she's got quite a fever.\nLet's get her somewhere with a bed.
Maybe exhaustion caught up with her.
Aoi…
(It's my fault…\nBecause I lost the Poketen…!)
// Fade to black\n// Background: inside Gamers
Is it true Aoi collapsed, nyo?
We took her to a nearby hospital\nand had a doctor look at her.\nShe took fever medicine and is sleeping now.
Is she sick, nyo?
Thing is, the doctors\ncan't figure it out.
They can't tell, nyo?\nQuack doctors, nyo!
Non non!\nOf course that doctor couldn't tell.\nHere's the thing.
What do you mean?
Judging from Boin-chan's condition,\nthat's an endemic disease from my world-\ncalled Tennetsu disease.
Tennetsu disease?
Yes-the fever climbs without limit\nuntil you start hallucinating angels.\nA terrifying disease.
That can be cured, right?
Left as-is, no~.\nIt's an incurable disease, after all.
Whaaat!? No way!!
Just kidding-total lie.\nBut until a miracle cure was found,\nit really was incurable.
Eve! Please stop joking\nat a time like this!

Sowwy sowwy!
We know a medicinal herb called
'Dark Stardust' works now,
so it's not that dangerous.
That herb can cure her!\nWhere is it!
It grows in a cave\nnear Saint Mont Blanc Academy~.
I think it was growing in a cave\nnear Saint Mont Blanc Academy?
Good memory. Smart, zo!
Then let's hurry there right away.
Good thing we can choose\nour destination now.
Haruka, please stay by Aoi's side.\nWe'll go pick the herb!
No, I'm going too!\nI want to do something for Aoi!
I might not be able to call\nthe Twin Angels yet, but…
That's fine.\nWe're not going to fight!
Right. Just go and pick it quickly.\nShouldn't be hard.
// Fade to black\n// Background: Akihabara (day)
Everyone's here?\nPoryal! Come on ouuut!
// Poryal appears
Now! Off we go, off we go!
I'll be back, Aoi!
// Light flares\n// Everyone vanishes.
Disappearance confirmed.
Let's go, Natchan.\nStealing the 'Angel's Tear' from Kannazuki\nat the hospital will be easy.
But…
…I can't say I have no doubts\nabout whether this is truly the right thing.
Kannazuki is a Twin Angel.\nBut the Twin Angels are not our enemy.
But we are Twin Phantoms.\nDaughters of Black Trader,\nmembers of the Black Fund.
Sis…
(Even though she didn't know anything,\nMinazuki helped us when we were in trouble.\nAnd yet we… …!)
// Fade to black\n// Background: the cave
The herb's in this cave, right?
Yes! It should be deeper inside~!
There's spring water in the back,\nand it was near there, I think.
It's a plant that grows in special conditions.\nMaybe it's related to something\nin the spring water.
We gotta get there fast!
The herb won't run away\njust because you dawdle. Unless it grows legs!
…Hm? Don't you hear something?
Huh?
// SE: explosion
Kya!!
What!? It came from the entrance!
We should head back and check.
Right! Let's go see!
// Fade to black\n// SE: footsteps walking\n// The party heads back to the entrance
Wh-what!? A cave-in at the entrance!?
I smell gunpowder!\nDid someone blow it up?
(Charles, this is…)
(A trap, maybe…)
Eve, do people come to this cave often?
Hmm… dunnooo☆
This is no time to be so carefree…
Don't worry.\nRocks and dirt like this?\nOne swing of my hammer'll…
No, Koto! The blast probably weakened\nthis whole area. Mess with it carelessly\nand we'll be buried alive!
Right. We and the IS units might be fine,\nbut we can't guarantee everyone's safety.
More importantly, we need to hurry\nand pick the herb!!
…That might be impossible.
Huh?
…An ambush, of all things.
// The rival appears
[NOEL]!? Why are you here~!?
I don't think any idiot would tell you.
[MERU]…!! What are you doing in a place like this!?
Even if you ask, I'm not telling~.
Aoi doesn't have much time…!\nPlease, let us pick the herb!!
Minazuki! Stay back!
// Battle map: the cave\n// Enemy and allied deployment
There's so many of them…!!
Can't chalk this up to coincidence.
Indeed…
Quite the thorough preparation.\nShould I celebrate my student's growth,\nor scold her mischief? I'm torn.
Teacher, this is wrong~!\nDoing this while Aoi's suffering\nis awful~!
True… but [MERU],\ncould you defy Teacher\ngoing this far?
I could never do that~!!
And that's exactly what\n[NOEL]'s doing.
I don't know the reason, but\nwouldn't I be a failed teacher\nif I didn't understand that resolve?
I don't understand~…\n[NOEL] defying Teacher…\nI don't understand at all~…
Then why not clash with all your might?\nYou might learn something that way, zo☆.
…I'll try~!
Teacher, stop [MERU]!
Hmm, isn't that what's strange?
What's strange about it!\n[MERU]'s the strange one!
[MERU]'s serious.\nI don't know why, but\nshe's standing before Teacher in earnest.
That's exactly what's strange!
How much resolve do you think it takes?\nYou know what defying Teacher means,\ndon't you, [NOEL]?
This is all crazy…\nUgh, I don't get it!!\nFine! I'll clash with her!!
That's right! That's the answer☆
// Battle start\n// Event triggers when the rival and [MERU] engage
[NOEL]!\nDo you really have to do this~?
You know my personality, right?\nThen you should understand!
// Event triggers when the rival and [NOEL] engage
[MERU]!\nYou're prepared to go down, I hope!
You're the one going down~…!
// Event triggers when the rival is defeated
Fufu, my show isn't over yet!\nBye-bye!
This much is… enough~!
// The rival character vanishes
We haven't settled this yet~!!
What's 'enough'! Fight me to the end!
Hmm, cute face and all…\nthat girl's got some skill.
Wait! More of them!?
// Enemy reinforcements appear. Riko also appears. Line up an absurd, impossible-looking number of them. Kurumi's arrival wipes out a huge chunk.
Heeey! Welcome to the monster house!\nJust kidding!
A two-stage setup, then.
This number…!
Fufun. A monster house is, like,\nabsolutely crawling with monsters.\nEnough to make you go 'oh, I'm doomed,' zo!
This cramped space makes it hard to fight!
And the exit's blocked…
Even if I take point,\nI can't block them all…!
Good good, nice faces, everyone!\nThat's the look of a group caught in a trap.\nNow then-surround and annihilate, all at once!
Mii, this is bad…
Goo! Monster armiiiies!
// SE: huge explosion\n// Screen shakes as Kurumi blows up the entrance.
An explosion!?
Honestly, Haruka's such a handful\nshe's gonna end up charred black!
Who are you!
Hmph! Before asking someone's name,\nthere are things to do first!
// Event CG: Kurumi appears, hurling Angel Bombs wildly.
Here I go!!
Angel Bombs!! Carpet bombing!!\nTake that, that, that, that!!
Blast off!!
// Explosions erupt across the map, wiping out tons of enemies at once.
Uwyaa!?
I-I'm gonna die…!!
No, wait…\nShe's precisely targeting\nonly the enemies…?
// Kurumi appears on the map.
Of course! Who do you think I am!!
Who are you!?
The phantom-thief angel! Twin Angel!!
There's only one of you!!
What do you mean!\nWith the Red Angel over there that makes two…\nhuh? She's not here!?
Mooou, for once I thought I could actually say\n'twin' today~! At this rate I'm a one-person\nTwin Angel!
A white Twin Angel…?
That's right, I'm White Angel!\nFine, I'll do the work of three!
And no pointing out that the numbers\ndon't add up either way!!
(She's bothered by it…)
Heh-heh, the tables have turned!\nTime for our big counterattack!
// Battle resumes\n// Event triggers when Riko and Kurumi engage
Just go down already!
A bomb-using thief-\nthat's overlapping with me, y'know.\nSorry, but could you change your character?
There! A phantom thief and a common thief\nare totally different! I'm way cuter, too♪
I've got the sex appeal advantage!
Shut up! Give me a year\nand I'll surpass you!
// Event triggers when Riko is defeated
Mmm, the monster house failed.\nShould've cranked the difficulty a bit higher.\nBalance tuning is hard!
// Riko vanishes
Vanishing in an instant from a cave like this\nis way more unbalanced!
Couldn't agree more.
Laura, you've done stuff like that too…
In my case, the movement was part of the plan.\nI wasn't using it freely.
Hmm, interesting~.\nSo there's a difference in how it's used.
Hey! Way too early to relax!\nFinish them all off before you chit-chat!
She's right. Let's clean up the rest!
// Clear when all enemies are defeated
That's that. Bye-bye!
// White Angel withdraws.
Ah, at least let us thank you!
Her identity's a secret too, then.
Let's ask Haruka for details.\nAnd we need to hurry with the herb picking.
That's the most important thing.
// Battle end\n// Background: the cave
Honestly! Aoi's in danger\nand Haruka's totally useless!
Sorry, Kurumi…
Haruka, this girl's the White Angel's…?
I'll introduce myself.\nI'm Kurumi Hazuki-the Heaven's Messenger\nwho summons White Angel!
As a Heaven's Messenger I'm not just green but half-boiled-\nno, I came all this way to babysit\ndumb raw-egg Haruka.
By the way, Kurumi, how did you get\nto this world?
It's a real mystery.
Honestly, can't anyone figure out\nsomething that obvious?
Did Eve teach you? Maybe? maybe?
Final answer?
U-um, final answer, maybe, mayybe.
Correct~! After I helped Sakimori-chan,\nNekomimi-chan came to Saint Cherine Academy,\nand that's where we met.
Sakimori-chan?
That's me. And 'Nekomimi-chan'\nmust be Hazuki.
I heard someone was after the 'Angel's Tear',\nso I rushed from Italy to the academy,\nbut Aoi and the others were already gone.
I'd asked her to stay behind and guard\nSaint Cherine Academy just in case, but\nwhen I told her Boin-chan collapsed…
I couldn't just sit still!\nEve taught me how to use Poryal,\nso I checked on Aoi first, then came here.
And sure enough, Haruka's been\ntotally useless!
Sorry…
Now now, everyone's safe,\nso let's go pick the herb!
Right.
Just one more question, if you please?\nYou blew up the cave entrance to get in,\nbut wasn't there a risk of collapse?
That's easy! You just calculate\nthe amount of explosives that lets people through\nbut barely avoids a collapse.
You can do that calculation that fast!?
White Angel did the calculating, though.\nFor her it's a piece of cake, probably.
Wow, she's smart.
Are we done with questions?\nFor Aoi's sake, the herb…
Yeees! One more questiooon!
Eeep!? You're the one from before!!
How many seconds do you think\nthis cave will hold?
Wh-what!?
Bye-bye-kii~n☆
// Riko vanishes
Wait!
// SE: rumbling, then a huge explosion\n// Screen shakes too.
Kya!!
An explosion deeper in the cave!?
// SE: bedrock crumbling
Bad! At this rate the whole cave\nwill collapse and bury us!
Let's run!
But the herb!!
Even so, we'll lose our lives\nbefore we can pick the herb!
Nooo! Without the herb, Aoi'll…!!
Calm down! There might be another way.\nIf we kick the bucket here,\nit'd all be for nothing!
Ugh…!
Herbs like that grow elsewhere too!\nNow that you get it, move! Hurry!
O-okay… sorry, Kurumi…
Honestly, you're such a handful.\nEveryone else, retreat! Quickly!
// Fade to black\n// Background: the original-characters' world
Wh-what… you're kidding…?
Sorry, but it's true. 'Dark Stardust'\nhas only ever been found in this cave.
What! Why didn't you say that first!
The cave completely collapsed.\nIt's buried.
I could dig it back up if asked,\nbut the herb probably didn't survive.
No… if Aoi can't be saved,\nwhat do I do…!
Calm down, Haruka.\nLet's go back and check on Aoi first,\nthen think. Okay?
But we need to find the herb\nas soon as possible!
I'll use my connections to search for the herb.\nThe rest of you head back to Boin-chan first.
Better to leave this world's matters to Eve.\nLet's head back for now.
I agree.
…Aoi… I'm sorry…\nI couldn't do anything…!
(Haruka…)
// Fade to black\n// Background: black
-Aoi's hospital room
Aoi… I'm sorry, I…!
Hey, what is this!?\nGrass… on top of Aoi?
Huh? This grass, I've seen it somewhere…?
Aaah! This is 'Dark Stardust'~!!
Hm? This grass looks familiar?
Wasn't 'Dark Stardust' this?
Really!?
// Fade to black\n// Background: inside Gamers
I'm fully recovered.\nSorry for all the trouble, everyone.
Thank goodness…\nFor a while I didn't know\nwhat would happen…
Really! Not only couldn't you pick the herb,\nyou nearly got buried under the cave-\nI thought I was done for!
Kurumi, you don't have to go that far…
This is me going easy!\nHaruka has zeero of the judgment and skill\na Heaven's Messenger needs!
Ugh… this reminds me of myself\nwhen I first became a Symphogear wielder…
I said some pretty harsh things to Tachibana too.\nBut I don't think that attitude was right-\nI regret it now, honestly.
I don't know about you two, but\nit's a fact that Haruka lacks awareness\nand is way too clumsy!
Yes…
Kurumi, you don't have to be so hard on her.\nHaruka is doing her duty properly.
Aoi, you're too soft on Haruka!\nThis isn't helping her at all!
By the way, who picked that herb\nfor us? Maybe? maybe?
Wasn't me.
By the time we got back here,\nit was already there.
Um, about that…\nactually… the 'Angel's Tear'\nhas gone missing.
Whaaat!?
Aoi, is that really true!?
Yes… it was there the day I collapsed,\nso probably while I was bedridden…\nI'm so sorry…
Almost like it was traded\nfor the herb.
You can't have anything without life.
Rika's right. You can't get a life back,\nbut with effort you can get things back.
Right! Aoi getting better\nis way more important!
Exactly! We just take back\nwhat was stolen. That's my- a phantom thief's job!

(Hazuki understands the weight of life
far better than I once did… admirable,
for one so young… no, perhaps because
she is so young.)
(Still, who on earth did this?)
// Fade to black\n// Background: Akihabara
Do you think I did something unnecessary?
…No.
I see… I sent the 'Angel's Tear'\nto Black Fund HQ.
And then… this…
The Twin Angels' transformation device\nthat Minazuki dropped. I'm torn\nabout what to do with it too.
Returning it, sending it to the Black Fund,\ndestroying it… none of it feels right…
Yeah…
//END
